title: [13/10/2024] Favourite subjects of 60 students from two schools
prompt: The chart below shows information about the favourite subjects of 60 students from two schools, school A and school B. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The chart gives information about the subject preferences of 60 students from School A and School B.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, sport was by far the most popular subject among the surveyed students in School A, which stood in contrast to School B, where crafts/drawing was the foremost choice. In addition, with the exception of sport and science, students at School B showed a stronger preference for all the other subjects

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding non-academic subjects, the majority of School A students mentioned sport as their favourite subject, at 36 out of 60 students, which was around 7 times higher than the figure for School B, at only 5 students. However, the opposite pattern was seen in crafts/drawing, which was the least preferred subject in School A. There, only 4 students were interested in it, whereas a corresponding 25 students in School B favoured it the most.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining subjects, languages ranked second in School B, as they were chosen by 18 students, almost double social science's figure, at 10 individuals. Meanwhile, School A recorded a similar level of preference for these two subjects, each attracting just about 5 students. Finally, the least popular subject in School B was science, as only 2 students preferred it, which was insignificant compared to School A's 9 students.
